# Graphs generated by k-expressions

The labeled graphs generated by $k$-expressions, with labels $0, \dots, k-1$, are those obtained from: a single vertex with any label $i$; the disjoint union of two generated labeled graphs; joining every vertex labeled $i$ to every vertex labeled $j$, for labels $i \ne j$, in a generated labeled graph; and relabeling every vertex labeled $i$ to $j$ in a generated labeled graph.
